activities.title: What can this notice establish?
activities.lede: Synthetic classroom material — this is not a historical quotation.

notes.body: The town committee plans to open a new reading room on Saturday. Volunteers are asked to bring books and help arrange the furniture.

notes.term: Read the limits of the evidence
notes.body: The notice states a plan and requests help. It does not establish whether the room opened, how many volunteers attended, or who could use it.

questions.stem: Identify two statements supported directly by the notice.
What additional evidence would you need to establish whether the reading room opened? Explain why.
